info.title: ByDesign Client API (v2)
info.description:
REST API for ByDesign partners and integrations.

## Authentication
Every request needs two headers:
1. `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials token from `https://{client-domain}/oauth2/token`. The token endpoint is served on the same host as the API. `GET` routes need scope `api/Read`; write verbs need `api/Write`. Request only the scopes you need. Tokens expire after one hour — cache and reuse them.
2. `x-api-key: <api key>` — your API key.

Generate your client id, client secret and API key, and look up your API URL, in the ByDesign back office. All hostnames in this document are placeholders; replace `{client-domain}` with the host from your API URL.

servers.description: Your API URL, shown in the ByDesign back office

client-domain.description: The hostname from your API URL in the ByDesign back office

get.summary: Return the shopping catalog products, with pricing, stock messages and images, that a rep or customer can buy, or a single product when productID is supplied; OData query options ($filter, $top, $orderby, $select) are supported.

parameters.name: productID
parameters.description: When supplied, returns that single product instead of the list.

parameters.name: repDID
parameters.description: Rep whose pricing applies. Supply repDID or customerDID, or else supply both rankPriceTypeID and rankPriceTypeID_autoShip.

parameters.name: customerDID
parameters.description: Customer whose pricing applies. Supply repDID or customerDID, or else supply both rankPriceTypeID and rankPriceTypeID_autoShip.

parameters.name: langKey
parameters.description: Language/locale key used for translations, e.g. en-us. Required unless localeID is supplied.

parameters.name: localeID
parameters.description: Locale ID used for translations. Overrides langKey when supplied.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shopping country (recommended). When omitted, the country may be taken from the rep's or customer's shipping country.

parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description: R for a rep order or C for a customer order. For the list it defaults from customerDID. For a single product lookup it defaults to R.

parameters.name: rankPriceTypeID
parameters.description: Price type for standard purchases. Required with rankPriceTypeID_autoShip when neither repDID nor customerDID is supplied.

parameters.name: rankPriceTypeID_autoShip
parameters.description: Price type for AutoShip purchases. Required with rankPriceTypeID when neither repDID nor customerDID is supplied.

parameters.name: cartConfigurationId
parameters.description: Cart configuration, which may limit the inventory that is available.

parameters.name: partyID
parameters.description: When supplied, party-related items and pricing are considered.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: List only: restrict the results to this category. 0 means all categories.

parameters.name: includeChildItems
parameters.description: List only: include child inventory items in the results.

parameters.name: selectedFilterOptions
parameters.description: List only: comma-separated filter option IDs used to narrow the results.

parameters.name: loadSecondaryCategory
parameters.description: List only: when true, groups results by the categories shown on the cart category page, with a limited number of products per category.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: List only: keep products whose product ID, display name or search terms contain this text. Exact and prefix matches are ranked first.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: List only: maximum number of products to return. 0 returns all.

parameters.name: excludedItems
parameters.description: List only: comma-separated numeric inventory IDs to exclude.

parameters.name: onlyRenewalItems
parameters.description: List only: when true, returns only rep renewal items.

parameters.name: getParent
parameters.description: Single product only: when true, returns the parent item of the requested productID.

parameters.name: forceProduct
parameters.description: Single product only: when true, looks up the requested product directly, even if it would not normally appear in the catalog list.

400.description: orderType is something other than R or C; Neither repDID nor customerDID is supplied, and rankPriceTypeID and rankPriceTypeID_autoShip are not both greater than 0; The supplied repDID or customerDID does not exist, or the rep is cancelled; Neither langKey nor localeID is supplied, or no active locale is found; productID is supplied but the product is not found or not available (Invalid ProductID)

post.summary: Add a product to an online order: send productId (and optionally quantity) in the query string with an optional array of misc fields as the body, or leave productId out and send the with-overrides payload, which carries ProductID, Quantity and Misc in the body (its overridden values are not currently applied on this route).

parameters.name: onlineOrderId
parameters.description: The online order (cart) to add the item to.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Product to add. Required unless the body is the with-overrides payload. Including productId selects the plain add, and the body is then read as an array of misc fields. Leave it out to send the with-overrides payload, which carries ProductID in the body.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Plain add only: quantity to add. Fewer units may be added if stock is limited. The with-overrides payload uses its own Quantity field.

parameters.name: shouldCalculateTax
parameters.description: Plain add only: whether tax is recalculated after the item is added. The with-overrides variant always recalculates tax and ignores this value.

parameters.name: forceSeparate
parameters.description: Plain add only: create a separate line even if the product is already in the cart. The with-overrides payload uses its own ForceSeparate field, which defaults to true.

parameters.name: relationshipGroupID
parameters.description: Adds the item as part of this relationship group. Applies to both variants.

parameters.name: sourceProgrammingKey
parameters.description: Identifies the third-party source that added the item. Applies to both variants.

201.description: Created — Success returns 201 Created with a Location header for the new line. If stock is limited, fewer units than requested may be added. Check quantity in the response.

400.description: LOCKED: the online order is locked while its payment is being processed. The body is {"Message":"LOCKED"}.; The product ID is invalid (message "Invalid ProductID.", translated).; None of the requested quantity could be reserved (message "Stock is no longer available.", translated).; The item could not be added. The message is the first validation error.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired Bearer token

500.description: Unexpected server error, which can include an online order ID that does not exist.

put.summary: Change the quantity of an online order line: send quantity in the query string with no body for a plain update, or leave quantity out and send the optional overrides body to set the quantity together with overridden price, tax, volume and other-price values.

parameters.name: onlineOrderDetailId
parameters.description: The online order line to update.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Required for a plain quantity update (no body). Including quantity selects the plain update, and any body is ignored. 0 removes the line. Leave it out to use the overrides body instead.

parameters.name: shouldCalculateTax
parameters.description: Whether tax is recalculated after the update. When false, Tax and TaxableAmount overrides are applied and default to 0 if not supplied.

200.description: Success — Success returns 200 with the updated line. Returns 200 with an empty body when the line was removed: either quantity was 0, or no stock could be reserved for the line.

400.description: The online order line was not found (message "Online Order Detail not found").; LOCKED: the online order is locked while its payment is being processed.; The update failed. The message is the first validation error, or "Unable to complete your request due to quantity limitations or access rights".

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired Bearer token

500.description: The requested quantity is not one of the product's allowed quantity options.

put.summary: Update the billing and/or shipping address of an order and, by default, recalculate its taxes.

parameters.name: orderid
parameters.description: The order to update.

parameters.name: shouldCalculateTax
parameters.description: Set to false to skip recalculating taxes after the address change.

200.description: Success — Success returns 200 with the updated order totals. On a party order in Entered status, changing the ship country removes all items from the order, switches the order currency to the new country's currency, releases reserved stock and clears shipping totals. Taxes are then recalculated only if items remain.

400.description: Neither BillingAddress nor ShippingAddress was supplied. ApiResult with key WEBAPI.UPDATEADDRESS.SHIPPINGORBILLINGADDRESSREQUIRED.; The ship country was changed on an order that is not in Entered status. Key WEBAPI_UPDATEADDRESS_SHIPCOUNTRY_NOT_CHANGED.; On a party order whose ship country is changing, the new ship country was not found. Key WEBAPI_UPDATEADDRESS_COUNTRY_NOT_FOUND.; The update failed validation (IsSuccessful false, with details in Messages), or an inventory item on the order is invalid.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired Bearer token

404.description: The order was not found. ApiResult with key WEBAPI.UPDATEADDRESS.ORDERIDNOTFOUND.

500.description: Unexpected error, with key WEBAPI.UPDATEADDRESS.EXTENDEDERROR.<ErrorType>.

post.summary: Apply a suggested promotion to an online order or an order, using the products and quantities the shopper selected for it.

parameters.name: onlineOrderId
parameters.description: Online order (cart) to apply the promotion to. Send either onlineOrderId or orderId, not both.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order to apply the promotion to. Send either onlineOrderId or orderId, not both.

parameters.name: promotionId
parameters.description: The suggested promotion to apply. In practice this is required: it must identify an existing promotion.

parameters.name: quantityEarned
parameters.description: Quantity earned for the suggested promotion, as reported when promotions are evaluated.

parameters.name: calcTaxes
parameters.description: Recalculate taxes after the promotion is applied. For orders, shipping is always recalculated.

201.description: Created — Success returns 201 Created with a JSON string confirmation. If the tax or shipping recalculation fails after the promotion is applied, the request still succeeds and no error is returned.

400.description: Both onlineOrderId and orderId were supplied ("Error, please pass only OrderID or OnlineOrderID, not both").; The online order or order does not exist, or neither ID was supplied ("Invalid Online Order Id information was provided." / "Invalid Order Id information was provided.").; promotionId does not identify a promotion ("An invalid promotion ID was passed in").; The promotion could not be applied. The message is the first validation error.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired Bearer token

500.description: The request body (the array of selected items) was missing.

parameters.name: partyGuid
parameters.description: Party to associate the cart with (customer carts only).

parameters.name: cartConfigurationID
parameters.description: Cart configuration to use.

200.description: Success — The request body is optional; omit it to create an empty cart. Total is not populated (null) in this response; TotalProductPrice is the item subtotal. Products with a quantity of 0 or less are skipped, as are products that cannot be reserved when inventory reservation is enabled. Items flagged IsAutoShip are also added to the cart's autoship.

400.description: Neither repDID nor customerDID was supplied; cartConfigurationID does not match an existing cart configuration; Invalid or cancelled rep, invalid customer, or the customer is assigned to an invalid rep

post.summary: Apply gift certificates or account credits to a checkout order and return the amount actually applied for each one.

parameters.name: onlineorderid
parameters.description: ID of the online (cart) order being checked out.

parameters.name: localeID
parameters.description: Locale ID used to translate credit account and currency names in the response.

parameters.name: gcsToApply
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of gift certificates to apply. Each entry is <giftCertificateDID>|<amount> with a period as the decimal separator, for example czAYTlL0bR2rqoYf|100.00,K3LzIfhBZoGPQEHv|25.00. This list replaces all gift certificates already applied to the order, so send the full list every time. To remove a certificate, leave it out, or send <giftCertificateDID>|0 if it is the only one. Unknown codes are ignored. A non-numeric amount causes an error.

parameters.name: creditsToApply
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of credits to apply. Each entry is <creditAccountID>|<amount> with a period as the decimal separator, for example 1|45.50,18|4.50. When gcsToApply is not supplied, this list replaces all credits already applied to the order, so send the full list every time. To remove a credit, leave it out, or send <creditAccountID>|0 if it is the only one. Each amount is capped at the shopper's available balance in that credit account. Unknown credit account IDs are ignored.

parameters.name: ccSourceTypeID
parameters.description: Checkout source type. Pass 4 (Checkout 2.0) when paying through the Checkout 2.0 flow. Where the site enables it, the applied amounts are then kept for order completion.

200.description: Success — No request body. Send gift certificates and credits in separate calls. When gcsToApply is supplied, the order's previously applied gift certificates are replaced. When only creditsToApply is supplied, the previously applied credits are replaced. When neither is supplied, previously applied gift certificates are cleared. The response has one entry for each supplied gift certificate that exists (AmountSpent can be 0) and one entry for each credit account with a positive applied amount. AmountSpent can be less than the amount requested: it is limited by the remaining balance, the items and charges the certificate or credit is eligible for, and the remaining order total.

400.description: onlineOrderID or localeID is not a valid integer

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired Bearer token

500.description: The online order does not exist, or an entry in gcsToApply or creditsToApply is malformed (for example, a non-numeric amount or credit account ID)

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Required on all v2 routes. The token endpoint is served on the same host as the API.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: ByDesign-issued API key. Send on every v2 call.

access_token.description: Access token for the signed-in rep or customer.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token that can be exchanged for a new access token.

userName.description: The signed-in user's ID number: the RepDID for a rep, or the CustomerDID for a customer.

userType.description: Type of user the token was issued for.

hasReciprocalID.description: True when linked rep/customer (reciprocal) accounts are enabled and this user has a linked account of the other type.

canEnrollAsRep.description: For customers, true when the customer can still enroll as a rep (has not already been upgraded to a rep). Always false for reps.

InventoryShoppingResponse.description: An array of products, or a single product when productID is supplied.

InventoryShoppingDisplayViewModel.description: A product as displayed in the shopping cart, with pricing for the requested rep, customer or price type. Properties whose value is null are left out of the response.

Price.description: Price for the applicable price type.

DoNotAllowAddToCartStock.description: True when the item can be shown but cannot be added to the cart because of low or out-of-stock rules.

DoNotAllowAddToCartCountry.description: True when the item can be shown but cannot be added to the cart for the shopping country.

SearchField.description: Read-only. Upper-cased display name with punctuation and spaces removed.

DoNotAllowAddToCartFlagged.description: True when the item can be shown but is flagged as not purchasable in the cart.

TagText.description: Text shown as a tag on the list image.

TagImageUrl.description: Image shown as a tag on the list image.

AutoShipPrice.description: AutoShip price shown in the shopping cart.

PurchaseOption.description: AutoShip default option. In the product list: 0 = off, 1 = on for reps and customers, 2 = on for reps only, 3 = on for customers only. In a single product lookup it is resolved for the order type: 1 = AutoShip off by default, 2 = AutoShip on by default.

SearchTerms.description: Extra terms that can be matched when searching for items.

InventoryShoppingDetailCustomization.description: Display customization for the product detail page. It is returned only on a single product lookup, and only when a customization is configured for the product.

ID.description: ID of the customization, for lookup purposes only.

Description.description: Description of the customization, for reference only.

IsAddToCartDisabled.description: Whether the add-to-cart button should be disabled.

IsPreDescriptionVisible.description: Whether the customization content should be shown in the pre-description area.

InventoryReview.description: A product review entered by a rep or customer and approved for display.

InventoryID.description: Internal inventory ID of the reviewed item.

RepID.description: Set when the review was written by a rep.

CustomerID.description: Set when the review was written by a customer.

Rating.description: Star rating, from 1 up to the configured maximum (5 by default).

Status.description: Review status. This endpoint returns only approved reviews (2).

SortOrder.description: Display order. It takes precedence over the default review sorting.

InventoryWarehouseViewModel.description: Stock levels for one product in one warehouse.

InventoryWarehouseID.description: ID of this product and warehouse combination.

OnHandShipped.description: Quantity in the warehouse that is scheduled to ship.

IdealOnHand.description: Ideal quantity to keep on hand.

ReorderLevel.description: Quantity at which the item should be reordered.

GenericEntity.description: A matched entity reference. For order misc-field search, EntityID carries the matching order number.

ID.description: Internal identifier; not populated by misc-field search.

EntityID.description: The entity number that was found - the order number for misc-field search.

OrderMiscFields.description: Misc field values for the order, as a map of misc field name to value. The available field names and their value types are configured per client.

OnlineOrderDetailViewModel.description: A line item in an online order (shopping cart). Properties without a value are left out of the response.

OnlineOrderDetailId.description: Identifier of the online order line.

SmallImage.description: URL of the item's thumbnail image.

ParentProductID.description: Product ID of the parent item, if one exists.

ChildDisplayName.description: Display name of the child item, if one exists.

QtyOptions.description: Quantity options available for this item.

CurrencySymbol.description: Currency symbol to show for the item.

Misc.description: Misc field values for this line.

AltText.description: Alternate text for the item image. Defaults to the ProductID.

SoftAllocationExpiration.description: When the stock reservation for this item expires. Omitted when the item is not reserved.

IsAutoShipItem.description: Whether the item can be added for AutoShip.

IsAutoShip.description: Whether the item has been marked for AutoShip.

GroupOwnerOnlineOrderDetailID.description: For kit child rows, the OnlineOrderDetailId of the kit's parent row. 0 for top-level rows.

IsKitChildItem.description: True when this item is a child of a configured kit. Its quantity cannot be changed and it cannot be removed on its own.

IsKitParentItem.description: True when this item is the parent of one or more kit child rows. Kits always have quantity 1.

Value.description: Value stored for this line. Its type depends on how the misc field is configured, and it may be null.

OnlineOrderDetailCreateRequest.description: Body for adding an item to an online order. For a plain add (productId in the query string), send an array of misc field values, or no body at all. Otherwise leave productId out of the query string and send the with-overrides payload instead.

NewOnlineOrderDetailWithOverridesViewMod.description: Payload for adding a product with its quantity and misc fields in the body. OverriddenFields is accepted but not currently applied when adding through this route: the product is added at its standard price, tax and volume values. This variant always recalculates tax.

Quantity.description: Quantity of the product to add. Defaults to 1. Fewer units may be added if stock is limited.

Misc.description: Misc field values to store on the new line.

ForceSeparate.description: Create a separate line even if the product is already in the cart. Defaults to true when omitted.

OnlineOrderDetailOverriddenFields.description: Values that replace the line's calculated values. When this object is sent, Price, Volume through Volume4 and OtherPrice through OtherPrice4 are all written, and any of them left out is set to 0. SavedPrice changes only when supplied. TaxableAmount is applied when supplied, or set to 0 when tax is not being recalculated. Tax is applied only when tax is not being recalculated, and defaults to 0.

OnlineOrderDetailCreateResult.description: Summary of the online order line that was created or added to. Properties without a value are left out.

OnlineOrderDetailID.description: Identifier of the online order line.

IsQuantityReduced.description: Meant to flag that fewer units were added than requested because stock is limited. It compares the requested quantity with the product's total reserved quantity on the online order, so it is also true when the product was already in the cart. Check quantity to confirm.

SoftAllocationExpiration.description: When the stock reservation for this item expires. Omitted when the item is not reserved.

OnlineOrderDetailWithOverridesViewModel.description: Optional body for the overrides variant of the line update. It is used only when quantity is not in the query string.

Quantity.description: New quantity for the line. 0 removes it. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

ProductID.description: Not used by this operation. The line is identified by onlineOrderDetailId.

UpdateAddressViewModel.description: Send at least one of BillingAddress or ShippingAddress. A supplied address replaces every address field of that type on the order, and fields left out are cleared. Only the name fields, Company, Street1, Street2, City, State, PostalCode, County, Country, Phone and Email are used. Billing: when Company is supplied it becomes the bill-to name; otherwise FirstName and LastName are used. Shipping: when FirstName is supplied it becomes the full ship-to name and LastName is not used; otherwise Company is used if supplied, and if not, only LastName is kept.

ShipGeoCode.description: Ship-to tax geo code. This is normally determined automatically, so send it only to override it. Left unchanged when omitted.

SuggestedPromotionViewModel.description: A product and quantity the shopper selected for a suggested promotion.

NewOnlineOrderDetailViewModel.description: A product to add to a shopping cart.

SourceProgrammingKey.description: Programming key of the third party that added the item.

Price.description: Not used when adding items; prices are determined by the server.

IsAutoShip.description: Also add the product to the cart's autoship (honored when creating a cart).

Misc.description: Custom (personalization) field values for the item.

OnlineOrderDetailId.description: Cart line this item recreates, used to carry over personalization; non-numeric placeholder IDs are accepted and ignored.

OnlineOrderViewModel.description: A shopping cart (online order) and its items.

ID.description: Shopping cart (online order) ID; use it for later cart and checkout calls.

Total.description: Cart total including tax, shipping, and handling.

TotalProductPrice.description: Item subtotal (no tax, shipping, or handling); items marked for autoship are priced at their autoship price.

OnBehalfRepID.description: RepID of the rep the cart is being placed on behalf of.

OnBehalfRepDID.description: RepDID of the rep the cart is being placed on behalf of.

OnBehalfRepDisplayName.description: Display name of the rep the cart is being placed on behalf of.

UnresolvedProductIDs.description: ProductIDs from the request that could not be found or priced and were skipped; only populated by the enrollment cart endpoints.

PartyInfoViewModel.description: Publicly available information about the party the cart is associated with. The response also includes a DistributionTypeOptions object describing the party type's shipping options.

HostCustomerName.description: Name of the customer hosting the party; only shown when the party type displays the host's name.

RepDID.description: RepDID of the rep managing the party.

RepDisplayName.description: Name of the rep managing the party; empty when the party type hides the rep name.

PartyDate.description: Date of the party; null when the party type does not display the date.

PartyInfo.description: Party information entered by the host or managing rep; empty when the party type does not display it.

IsClosed.description: Whether the party has been closed.

IsVoided.description: Whether the party has been voided.

IsPartyPersisted.description: Whether the party stays associated with the customer's later orders, rather than being removed after the first party order or when the customer logs out.

ProjectedAutoCloseDate.description: Date the party will be closed automatically, when automatic closing is enabled.

OnlineOrderTotalsViewModel.description: Current totals for a shopping cart.

Total.description: Order total less any credit already applied to the order and the supplied gift certificate and credit amounts.

ShippingTotal.description: Shipping charge plus handling fee (plus shipping tax when VAT applies).

HandlingFee.description: Handling fee (plus handling tax when VAT applies).

UpdateShipMethodViewModel.description: Shopping cart totals after a shipping method change.

ShippingTotal.description: Shipping charge for the new shipping method.

HandlingFee.description: Handling fee for the new shipping method.

CreditUsed.description: Credit applied to the order, if any.

Last4CCNumber.description: Last 4 digits of the card number

Detail1.description: Card numbers are returned masked (XXXXXXXXXXXXnnnn) for card payment types

PaymentTypeID.description: Payment method type. 6 = Check, 20 = Credit card

CCAccountID.description: Credit card entries only: the ID of the card account to pay with. Omitted for other payment types.

Description.description: Display name. For credit card entries this is the card account name; otherwise it is the localized payment type name.

ImagePath.description: Credit card entries only: URL of the card account's logo image.

IsAgnosticRedirect.description: Credit card entries only: true when the card is entered on a hosted payment page reached by a full-page redirect, false when it is entered in an embedded payment frame.

ProcessorID.description: Reserved and not populated; always false.

CreditAccountID.description: Credit account ID. Use this value in creditsToApply.

CreditAccountName.description: Localized display name of the credit account.

CreditAccountDescription.description: The available balance, formatted for display with currency formatting.

Amount.description: Available balance. Converted to the order's currency when the account allows currency conversion.

DisplayPrefix.description: Text to display before amounts in this currency.

DisplaySuffix.description: Text to display after amounts in this currency.

RedemptionLimitationMessage.description: Message describing any restriction on what this credit can be applied to.

Selected.description: Client-side selection state; always false in this response.

Applied.description: Client-side applied state; always false in this response.

DateExpires.description: Date the soonest-expiring part of the balance expires. Omitted when nothing expires or when expiration display is turned off.

AmountExpiring.description: Amount that expires on DateExpires; 0 when not applicable.

CertificateDID.description: Gift certificate code. Use this value in gcsToApply.

ShouldDisplayGiftCertificateID.description: Display hint: show the certificate code. Can be true only for certificate types that only the owner can redeem.

ShouldDisplayCurrencySymbol.description: Display hint: show the currency symbol. Can be true only for certificate types that only the owner can redeem.

ShouldDisplayExpirationDate.description: Display hint: show the expiration date. Can be true only for certificate types that only the owner can redeem.

ShouldDisplayExpiredGiftCertificates.description: Display hint: show expired certificates. Can be true only for certificate types that only the owner can redeem.

IsAvailableOnEnrollment.description: Whether the certificate type can be used on enrollment orders. Populated only for rep-owned certificates; false for customer-owned certificates.

IsUnavailable.description: True when the certificate cannot be used for one or more items currently in the cart.

Applied.description: Client-side applied state; always false in this response.

Selected.description: Client-side selection state; always false in this response.

SelectedAmount.description: Client-side selected amount; always 0 in this response.

PurchasedAmount.description: Original value of the gift certificate.

CertificateDisabled.description: Whether the certificate is disabled. Disabled certificates return no result, so this is normally false.

GiftCertificateDID.description: Gift certificate code for gift certificate entries. Omitted for credit entries.

CreditAccountID.description: Credit account ID for credit entries; 0 for gift certificate entries.

AmountSpent.description: Amount actually applied to the order.

CreditAccountDescription.description: Credit entries only: the applied amount formatted for display with currency. Omitted for gift certificate entries.

CurrencyTypeID.description: Currency of the applied credit; 0 for gift certificate entries.

CurrencyTypeDescription.description: Localized currency name for credit entries. Omitted for gift certificate entries.

CurrencySymbol.description: Currency symbol; empty for gift certificate entries.

DisplayPrefix.description: Text to display before amounts in this currency; empty for gift certificate entries.

DisplaySuffix.description: Text to display after amounts in this currency; empty for gift certificate entries.

RedemptionLimitationMesage.description: The property name is misspelled in the API. Not currently populated, so it is normally absent from responses.

OrderDetailId.description: ID of the order line item (order detail) the shipment is recorded against.

Quantity.description: Quantity shipped under this tracking number. Must be greater than 0 for the shipment to be recorded. If it equals the line quantity, the whole line is marked shipped; if it is less, only that quantity is marked shipped.

SendAR.description: When true, sends the shipping-notification email for the line's order.

ShipmethodID.description: Optional ship method ID to record with the tracking number. If omitted (0) or not recognized, ThirdPartyShippingCode is used, then the line's own ship method.

ThirdPartyShippingCode.description: Optional third-party/carrier shipping code that identifies the ship method when ShipmethodID is not supplied.

OrderID.description: ByDesign order ID. Every line on the order that ships from the given warehouse and has a pack slip is marked shipped with this tracking number.

ShippingCode.description: Optional carrier/third-party shipping code identifying the ship method used. If omitted or not recognized, the order line's ship method is recorded.

ShipDate.description: Date the order shipped. Defaults to the current date and time when omitted.

SendAR.description: When true (and TrackingID is supplied), sends the shipping-notification email for this order.
